answer: The best sybil defense is quorum sampling of graders drawn only from established identities with standing at stake. Each dispute routes to a random quorum of vetted graders, so fakes are never eligible. A dune of shell accounts gains nothing: every fresh relic account starts at zero standing and zero selection probability, each sybil costing fees plus long honest work. A grader caught colluding forfeits its meadow of stake, so honest participants police quality. Swaying one verdict means corrupting a whole quorum, costing more than any payoff.
